lanes.summary: The receipt and the roadmap diff name different merge shas for PMAT-2154. One of them is wrong, so the receipt claim is not backed by the diff. The other nine rows match the receipt table. I could not run git in this lane, so I could not check which sha is real.

findings.claim: The PMAT-2154 notes sentence names merged sha f674c48ffdddbf612ab445b103c7c838e6d5bd31 (PR #2156). The receipt table for the same row says dbbe8a51. The ticket's done_when is 'the merged sha in notes, and that sha is an ancestor of origin/main'. The receipt says every sha was checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`. That cannot hold for both values. Whichever one is not the real merge of #2156 makes the row wrong.
findings.fix: Run `git log --format=%H -1 --grep='#2156' origin/main` and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main`. Use that full sha in both roadmap.yaml and the receipt table, then re-verify all ten rows.
